build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems with PBC and soft or hard knn
build_radius_graph_single: build a radius graph for a single atomic system with displacement vectors and envelope values
compute_safe_norm: compute the L2 norm of a tensor with epsilon protection against division by zero
compute_soft_rank: compute soft rankings for pairwise distances using a sigmoid-based differentiable k-nearest neighbor approach
compute_envelope_fn: compute the envelope function in log space that smoothly vanishes to negative infinity at x equals 1
